group.title: Core
group.description: Relative geometry every mode of analysis shares, as legacy Debrief's Tote showed it.

measures.title: Range from the primary
measures.label: Range
measures.subject: relative
measures.explanation: The geodesic distance from the primary to the track (WGS84).

measures.title: Bearing from the primary, true
measures.label: Brg
measures.subject: relative
measures.explanation: The direction from the primary to the track, true, along the geodesic.

measures.title: Relative bearing: from the primary's head, red to port, green to starboard
measures.label: Rel
measures.subject: relative
measures.explanation: The bearing less the primary's course: negative (red) to port, positive (green) to starboard.

measures.title: Angle on the bow: the primary's bearing from the track's head, red to port, green to starboard
measures.label: AOB
measures.subject: relative
measures.explanation: The bearing from the track to the primary less the track's course: the track's aspect as the primary sees it, negative (red) to port, positive (green) to starboard.

measures.title: Bearing rate: how fast the bearing from the primary changes, right positive
measures.label: Brg rate
measures.subject: relative
measures.explanation: The rate of change of the true bearing from the primary, from both tracks' courses and speeds: positive drawing right (clockwise), negative drawing left.

measures.title: Course
measures.label: Crse
measures.subject: own
measures.explanation: The course recorded at the fixes either side, interpolated the shorter way round; else the direction of the track there.

measures.title: Speed
measures.label: Spd
measures.subject: own
measures.explanation: The speed recorded at the fixes either side, interpolated; else the leg's length over its duration.

measures.title: Depth
measures.label: Depth
measures.subject: own
measures.explanation: The depth recorded at the fixes either side, interpolated; none where none is recorded.
